core_obligations: Choose the distinguished triangle N -> E -> Rj_*(E|_U) -> N[1]; condition (1) says tau_{>= a}N = 0, and tau_{>= a}N = 0 implies (1) with the variant range tau_{>= a+1}N = 0 giving (1) for a + 1.
Since K restricts to zero on U, Hom(K[-n], Rj_*(E|_U)) = 0; hence condition (2) is equivalent to Hom(K[-n], N) = 0 for all n >= a.
By the Koszul multiplication triangles, Hom(K[-n], N) = 0 for all n >= a is equivalent to Hom(K_e[-n], N) = 0 for all n >= a and all e >= 1.
N is supported on Z, so by the carded representation lemma this is equivalent to H^n(X, N) = 0 for all n >= a.
N is determined by R Gamma(X, N) via the affine comparison; conclude (2) is equivalent to tau_{>= a}N = 0, proving both implications.
proof_roadmap: Triangle setup; orthogonality transfer to N; Koszul powers; representation lemma; module-complex determination.
